method: primary letters and captivity record cross-checked against two independent peer-reviewed translation histories

important_deltas.finding: Full translation completion is moved from the vague 1840 endpoint to 31 January 1834.
19 December 1832 is retained as the completion of New Testament printing, not the completion of the whole Bible.
24 October 1840 is identified as the last sheet of a major revised quarto edition, preserving the distinction between translation and revision.
The post rejects a from-scratch solitary-genius framing and retains predecessor Catholic and Baptist language materials.

unsupported_popular_claims.claim: Judson first finished the entire Burmese Bible in 1840.
Judson created Burmese Christian vocabulary without meaningful predecessors.
Judson continuously translated the Bible in prison throughout the 1824–1826 captivity.

claim_upgrade_conditions.upgrade_requires: dated Judson or Ann Judson document locating the translation work inside captivity

visual_plan.concept: page/facsimile carrying the 1834 completion or 1840 revised-edition letter
